summary: Builds a block of scaled texture-coordinate data from a descriptor object (a2) and submits it through a vtable call on the DirectX object held at this offset 0x1100. Guarded by the flag at this offset 0x13D8 and by a4 != 1. Stores vtable call results into *this (offset 0x0) and returns -1 on failure, 0 on success.

local_names.v16: DX object pointer loaded from this[1088] (offset 0x1100)
local_names.v20: 26-dword scratch array holding the vertex/texture-coordinate block
local_names.v18: return value of the main vtable call

operations.description: Proceed only when the guard flag this[1270] (offset 0x13D8) is non-zero and a4 is not 1; otherwise return 0 without updating.
Zero-initialize a 26-dword (104-byte) local scratch array used to build the texture-coordinate block.
Switch on the descriptor type (low 3 bits of the dword at a2): case 1 sets element 0 to 3 and element 19 to literal 1399379109; cases 2 and 4 set element 0 to 1 and element 19 to the dword at a2+80.

Fill float elements of the scratch array with scaled products of descriptor fields: elements 1-3 are (a2+24, a2+28, a2+32) times (a2+36); elements 5-7 are (a2+40, a2+44, a2+48) times (a2+52); elements 9-11 are (a2+8, a2+12, a2+16) times (a2+20). Copy dwords from a2+56 through a2+76 into elements 13-18.
Set element 21 to literal 1065353216 (float 1.0) and elements 22 and 23 to zero.
Load the DX object from this[1088] (offset 0x1100), call its vtable slot 176 (offset 0xB0) as (object, a3, scratch array), and store the result into *this (offset 0x0).
If the vtable call returned non-zero, return -1 to signal failure.
If the low bit of the descriptor dword at a2 is set, call vtable slot 184 (offset 0xB8) as (object, a3, 1) and store the result into *this (offset 0x0).

clean_pseudocode: switch (*(int *)a2 & 7) { case 1: scratch[0]=3; scratch[19]=1399379109; break; case 2: case 4: scratch[0]=1; scratch[19]=*(int *)(a2+80); break; }
fill scaled texture coordinates from a2 descriptor fields; scratch[21]=1065353216; scratch[22]=0; scratch[23]=0;
result = call vtable[176](object, a3, scratch); *this = result; if (result) return -1;
